# Storage

## Rules
- Active directories use `YYYYMMDD-HHmmss-<name>` from `createdAt`; prefix is filesystem-only. `FsChangeRepository` resolves `*-<name>`. `ChangeRepository.list()` returns `createdAt` ascending through `{configPath}/tmp/fs-cache/changes/` index.
- Load derives artifact status from `validatedHash`: `__skipped__` to skipped; absent file to missing; cleaned SHA-256 match to complete; otherwise in-progress. Cleaning applies artifact `preHashCleanup`, collapses whitespace, trims, hashes. Bypass status derivation and drift when `artifactTypes.length === 0`.
- With resolved types, load detects validated baseline drift and calls `Change.invalidate("artifact-drift", SYSTEM_ACTOR, ...)` once with focused grouped payload; skip sentinel and already-reviewing files. Persist resulting history when load path writes manifest. `ValidateArtifacts` owns consent-hash drift only.
- `projectArtifacts` and `effectiveStatus` own recursive requires cascade: parent review may yield pending-parent review; incomplete parent yields in-progress; skipped optional parent satisfies dependency. Rewrite persisted legacy `pending-parent-artifact-review` to in-progress; `ArtifactFile` rejects token. No `Change.effectiveStatus()`.
- Only `ValidateArtifacts` calls `Artifact.markComplete(hash)`; only skip use case calls `Artifact.markSkipped()` and writes sentinel.
- `storage.archive.pattern` supports `{{year}}`, `{{month}}`, `{{day}}`, `{{change.name}}`, `{{change.archivedName}}`; default `{{change.archivedName}}`. Reject scope or workspace tokens with `UnsupportedPatternError`; year four digits, month and day zero-padded.
- Archive list index lives at `{configPath}/tmp/fs-cache/archive/`: `.specd-index.jsonl` rows `{ entry, sourceMtime?, sourceFiles? }`; meta `{ totalCount, generatedAt, isInvalidated }`. `reindex()` rebuilds from manifests and removes legacy root index. Normal cache hits neither scan nor delete root files. `get(name)` never requires root JSONL.
- Archive root `.gitignore` always ignores `.staging`; runtime creation and staged-commit paths preserve hygiene and never restore obsolete index lines.
- Named storage factories select adapters; workspace VCS or null-VCS decisions remain inside factory.
- `core:change-manifest` defines manifest format. Writes use atomic temp plus rename. Fs repositories reject root escapes and arbitrary untracked paths. Multi-update archive prepares full result then commits. Debug logs cover artifact resolution, confinement rejection, staged commit progress, failure diagnostics.
- Change locks live at `{configPath}/tmp/change-locks`, derived from repository config.
- Fs list caches live under `{configPath}/tmp/fs-cache/{archive,changes,drafts,discarded,specs/<workspace>,validate-specs/<workspace>}/`; repositories access via `FsChangeIndexCache` or `FsSpecIndexCache`; `include*` only projects responses.
- Validation bucket meta extends shared shape with `schemaFingerprint`, `engineVersion`; rows `{ entry, stamps, cacheFingerprint }` where fingerprint hashes sorted spec fingerprint plus metadata content hash or `__absent__`. Delivery hosts expose no validate-cache-specific surface.
- First tmp use and project initialization idempotently create `{configPath}/tmp/.gitignore` containing `*` and `!.gitignore`.

## Constraints
- Manifest writes atomic; staged archives never expose partial permanent state.
- Serialized fs-cache paths use forward slashes on every OS.
- Directory timestamp comes from `change.createdAt`.
- `{configPath}/tmp/fs-cache/` is runtime-only and never committed.
